packages.name: texturecraft-core
packages.description: TextureCraft document model: projects, texture sets, channels, layers, masks, effects and blend math

packages.name: texturecraft-texel
packages.description: TextureCraft texel storage: sparse copy-on-write tiles, UV padding, noise

packages.name: texturecraft-geom
packages.description: TextureCraft geometry: meshes, primitives, tangents, BVH ray casts, UV G-buffer, camera

packages.name: texturecraft-compose
packages.description: TextureCraft layer-stack compositor (CPU reference), patterns, UV padding, display conversion

packages.name: texturecraft-bake
packages.description: TextureCraft mesh-map baking: high-poly transfer (cage, match by name) of normal, height, AO, bent normals, curvature, thickness, ID, opacity, color, position and world-space maps

packages.name: texturecraft-formats
packages.description: TextureCraft file formats: mesh import (glTF, FBX, COLLADA, USD, OBJ, PLY, STL), glTF/USD/OBJ mesh export, texture export presets, the .tcraft project file

packages.name: texturecraft-paint
packages.description: TextureCraft brush engine: strokes, stamps, visibility, texture-space rasterization, commit

packages.name: texturecraft-engine
packages.description: TextureCraft session, command registry, painting, baking and inspection

packages.name: texturecraft-render
packages.description: TextureCraft wgpu viewport renderer: PBR, image-based lighting, debug views, UV view

packages.name: texturecraft-automation
packages.description: TextureCraft automation: MCP server (rmcp), headless JSON-lines RPC and a bridge to the running app

packages.name: texturecraft-ui-egui
packages.description: TextureCraft's egui shell: docks, toolbars, viewports and windows

packages.name: texturecraft
packages.description: TextureCraft: an open-source 3D texture painter (desktop app)

packages.name: texturecraft-cli
packages.description: Headless TextureCraft: info, run, batch, bake, export, render, MCP server, JSON-lines server

packages.name: texturecraft-web
packages.description: TextureCraft in the browser (eframe web runner, WebGPU with WebGL2 fallback)

packages.name: xtask
packages.description: TextureCraft workspace tooling: `cargo xtask <command>` (layers, wasm, ci, version, ico, icns)
